line: Safety Continuity & Execution Occurrence Closure (claude/v1-core-safety-continuity, from 48e428f = COACHINGCORE-V1-CORE-SAFETY-FREEZE-6)
note: The tests that fail on this line and passed on 48e428f. None is edited: each file is bound by an earlier freeze. FREEZE-6's 37 failures are unchanged in title. Successors are in test/v1core-sc-successors.test.mjs; each runs the frozen test from a temporary copy with only the listed substitutions, each matched exactly once (the mechanism of v1core-o1-successors.test.mjs).

entries.title: O-1: a kept voice is never dose: the flagged row's amount is the first-admitted report's, and the restart pause reads no occurrence from a head-on dispute
entries.contract: C-O1-2 (SSCTR_O1_R1 decision A): a head-on dispute whose every well-formed voice says the session took place is an occurrence for the pause
entries.before: the pause read as a flagged row of one voice (no occurrence; P2 interim)
entries.after: the pause reads as the device run alone; a flagged row of one voice still shows no occurrence; the amount, flag and unmerged voices as before
entries.sporting: restart pause shorter by the disputed session (it took place); no minutes, days or credit (C-Q08-1 unchanged)

entries.title: A12: the information to resolve a conflict is missing (a direct conflict keeps one voice): bounded, and no occurrence read
entries.contract: C-O1-2; since O-1 a direct conflict keeps both voices (the test title's premise is FREEZE-5's)
entries.after: [recent, lastExecuted, pause.bySportDays.RUN] = [ZERO, DAY-3, 3]: an occurrence; the stated exposure still bounded at zero
entries.sporting: pause read from the disputed session; exposure bound unchanged

entries.title: B4-B5: occurrence itself disputed (a voice says not done), or one voice only on the record (direct conflict): not an execution
entries.before: a direct conflict and a run 13 days ago: RUN pause 13
entries.after: RUN pause 3 (the direct conflict, both voices done, is an occurrence); exposure as the 13-day run alone. The 'not done' assertions are unchanged

entries.title: B7: what a row must show to be read as a disputed execution (a forged or partial flag reads as no execution, and never raises the bound)
entries.contract: C-O1-2: CONFLICTING_PHYSICAL_OR_RESPONSE_REPORTS with two well-formed 'done' voices is now an occurrence; integrity flags are not
entries.before: a CONFLICTING_PHYSICAL_OR_RESPONSE_REPORTS row with two done parts: no occurrence
entries.after: an occurrence with its amount not counted (recent ZERO); EVENT_ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_FACTS, ACTIVITY_BOUND_TO_TWO_SESSIONS or no named conflict on the same row: no occurrence (added); the one-voice and malformed assertions unchanged
entries.safety: a forged flag still never raises the bound
